note: Check 1 (non-sovereign office words): rows or reigns whose governor-like office is the row's own head (hereditary governor dynasties: Tahirids, Khwarazm, Córdoba). Key: a row id (all its hits) or a reign uuid; value: why. Reviewed by the Architect.

allow.tahirid-dynasty: the Tahirids were hereditary governors of Khurasan, and the row is their dynasty
allow.khwarazmian-empire: Anushtegin Gharchai, governor of Khwarazm, founded the dynasty the row covers
allow.reign-mateo-de-toro-zambrano-chile: Mateo de Toro Zambrano presided over Chile's first national junta in 1810; his infobox calls the office Royal Governor
allow.reign-lorenzo-latorre-uruguay: Lorenzo Latorre ruled Uruguay as Provisional Governor 1876 and then as dictator and president: the head of the state
